messages:
Ivy (product): Launch note: Adaptive Routing for Hosted API is GA. This feature dynamically routes requests across model variants, regions, and capacity tiers to hit latency & cost targets. Rolling to all regions over 24h. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/adaptive-routing

Kaito (eng-runtime): Short tech summary: router evaluates request hints, latency SLO, and cost profile. It can fall back to quantized or lower-capacity variants automatically. New request header to influence behavior: X-RW-Routing: cost|latency|balanced.

Renee (infra): Quick curl for latency-pref routing:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/async-route \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-RW-Routing: latency' \
  -d '{"model_hint":"rwd-compat-medium","input":"Draft a release note","async":true}'
```

Kaito (eng-runtime): Note: async tool invocations are supported but still require org-level enablement. Per-request override header X-RW-Tool-Override: allow|deny will be honored only if org has tools enabled.

Omar (devex): SDK updates: @redwood/sdk v3.5.0 adds asyncRoute() helper and high-level routing options. We'll update quickstarts and sample apps later today.

Priya (support): New error code ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE (429) returned when adaptive router can't meet requested SLOs and no fallback is permitted. KB update incoming: how to use X-RW-Routing and Model-Alias to pin behavior.

DeployBot: rollout:adaptive-routing v1 -> canary:eu-west-1 \u2705 started at 1802501310, est complete 1802504910.

Renee (infra): Observability: added routing.choice and routing.fallback_count metrics to Console. Please monitor P95 latency, fallback rate, and cost_per_token for the next 72h.

Ivy (product): Action items: 1) update internal quickstarts to call asyncRoute(), 2) ensure customer docs mention X-RW-Routing, 3) enterprise PMs confirm Dedicated/Private compatibility. Reply here when done.

Kaito (eng-runtime): If you see unexpected fallback patterns, enable debug headers (X-RW-Debug: routing) and ping #eng-runtime. We'll expose more debug fields on request logs for tenants with active debug.

Ivy (product): Thanks team  big step toward predictable latencies and lower unit cost. Watch support queues for feedback.
